title: Research Foundation & Predictive Evidence Update
database_migration: Adds a separate additive models_evidence/research_evidence.sqlite schema 1.1.0. Field Operations, Maize Pollination Lab and AgroLattice Twin SQLite schemas are unchanged. Safe migration now snapshots/migrates the Research Evidence DB when it exists and remains compatible with 11.2 sources that do not contain it.
key_features: Additive Research Model, Dataset, Observation, Prediction, Recommendation and Outcome Registry with model cards and provenance
Agricultural validation protocols: grouped CV, leave-one-year-out, leave-one-region-out, leave-one-group-out and forward/walk-forward validation
Leakage-safe model laboratory with preprocessing fitted inside training folds and optional XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost and TabPFN backends
Data-readiness checks before model fitting, including target observation, feature completeness and validation-split structure
Prediction registry supports numeric regression outputs plus categorical class labels and probability maps
Universal recommendation/outcome forms preserve proposed action, applied treatment and measured outcome as separate records
Environmental Pest & Disease Early Warning adaptation using Wadhwa & Malik environmental feature engineering, fold-contained SMOTE-ENN, model comparison and SHAP support
Central phenology service combining generic thermal-time staging with the unchanged Mechanistic Maize Twin
CropNet, YieldSAT and WorldCereal benchmark metadata/adapters without bundling large external datasets
Validation-weighted multimodal late-fusion baseline with missing-modality handling and explicit non-Bayesian disagreement reporting
Persistent Twin hooks for registered research predictions and recommendations
Country-switch state isolation extended to new research/pest/phenology/fusion workflows
Source-authoritative migration extended to research evidence/model artifacts
limitations: Research models are prototypes until validated on independent site/season data and promoted through the model registry.
External benchmark data are not bundled; users must obtain datasets under their original terms and register local snapshots.
Inter-modality spread is disagreement, not calibrated predictive uncertainty.
Pest prediction is not disease confirmation; pest-disease mappings are decision-support context only.
TabPFN is optional and not required to start AGROLATTICE.
